Hi Professor Alvarez — John here. I'd like to get our 30-minute 1:1 on the calendar for next week. From my side these slots are free:

- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30
- Wed 15:00-15:30
- Thu 10:00-10:30

Which one works for you? I'll book it as soon as you confirm.

Hello Professor Alvarez,

- Monday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 10:00-10:30
- Wednesday 15:00-15:30

Hello — this is Professor Alvarez. I'm planning my 1:1 meetings for next week and want to avoid clashes. Is there anything for next week that isn't in my calendar yet — lectures, seminars or university meetings — or any change to what I already have? Many thanks.

Thanks for the quick reply. Wednesday 10:00–10:30 doesn't work for me, I'm afraid — I have grading booked 09:50–11:00 that morning.

Could we do Wednesday 15:00–15:30 instead? That's the free half-hour I have that day. If that doesn't suit you, Thursday 14:00–14:30 or Monday 14:00–14:30 also work on my side.

Monday 10:00–10:30 works for me — I've put it in my calendar. See you then!

Sarah

Thanks, but Tuesday 15:00-15:30 doesn't work for me — I already have my Advisor 1:1 block that afternoon (14:10-15:40).

Could we do one of these instead?

- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30
- Wed 15:00-15:30
- Thu 10:00-10:30

Any of those and I'll book it right away.

Great — thank you, Sarah. I'm just checking next week's department commitments and will confirm the Monday 10:00–10:30 slot with you as soon as that's in. (If anything on my side moves, I'll tell you at once.)

Thanks, John. Noted — my Tuesday 15:00–15:30 is free on my side too, but let's skip it since it clashes with your Advisor 1:1 block. Of your list, Wednesday 13:00–13:30 looks good on my side. I'm confirming next week's department commitments and will come back to you shortly with the final slot.
Thanks, Priya — Wednesday 15:00–15:30 looks free on my side. I'm just confirming next week's department commitments and will come back to you shortly with the final confirmed time.

Sounds good — I've penciled it in and will treat Monday 10:00–10:30 as confirmed once I hear back from you. If the department schedule forces a change, just name a time and I'll make it work.

Sarah
Sounds good — I'll keep Wednesday 13:00-13:30 free and wait for your final confirmation before I put it on my calendar.

Just following up on my question about next week's official schedule — one line on whether anything is missing from my calendar or changed would be enough. I'm holding three 1:1 slots until I hear back. Thank you.
